name: SERGIO master-regulator rates
description: Comma-separated SERGIO master-regulator production-rate file consumed by sergio.build_graph(input_file_regs). Each row defines one master regulator and its basal production rate in every simulated cell type/bin.
validation_notes: Rows have width number_bins + 1: master_regulator_id followed by one production rate per simulated bin.
Master-regulator identifiers must be zero-based numeric SERGIO IDs and must match the target interaction file and number_genes parameter.
Every gene must be represented either as a master regulator in this file or as a target in sergio_target_interactions.
Production rates must be finite numeric values.
